Vendored dependencies for the SDL2 desktop build:

- Dear ImGui (master 2026-11-11, v1.93.1 WIP): core + SDL2/SDL_Renderer2 backends; MIT license in imgui/LICENSE.txt.
- miniz 2.2.0 (public domain): ZIP reading/writing for .conlang.
- nlohmann/json single header (from system, 3.11.x, MIT): JSON data files.
